prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. New GDD enemy BODY animation: Kiếm Nô Khôi Lỗi, exact southeast: front three-quarter lower RIGHT in every pose.
Image1 OWN same-view neutral is the motion/camera target. Image2 Wang same-view supports pixel treatment/camera only. Image3 OWN approved enemy is PRIMARY anatomy, age, identity and materials. Do not adopt Wang face, hair, small humanoid build or costume.
Identity: OWN approved broad squat cracked-stone construct, jagged stone face, aged bronze bindings and chest tablet. Keep 72px anatomy; no human skull, hair or cloth shoes.
Exactly 6 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS. ROW1: six identical own standing/floating neutral calibration figures.
ROW2: idle: stable heavy neutral / small shoulder compression / chest settles / weight settles through both stone feet / shoulders relax / stable heavy neutral.
ROW3: hit: heavy neutral / chest twists slightly backward / strongest stone torso recoil with feet planted / shoulders rebound forward / stone arms settle / heavy neutral.
ONE scale for the complete source from the neutral calibration, nominal 72 native pixels. Keep own skull/armor dimensions throughout. Lean, compression, crouch and fall lower the pose naturally; never fit per-pose height. Keep actual camera and anatomical rear occlusion in all actions. Rear hands do not show through torso, mantle or hair.
Compact attached hands/fingers for human/spirit; complete heavy stone fists for construct. Both actual stone feet/boots stay attached where applicable; spectral character has NO boots or invented walking legs. No mirrored view or flipped costume. All figures isolated by generous transparent gutters, with ample margins for complete hair, fists and prone body on all edges.
Truly transparent RGBA, crisp stepped pixel contours and limited shade bands. Body/outfit only; no floor, shadow, captions, grid, held weapon, projectile, detached shards, duplicate actor, warning ring, spell glow, smoke, aura or external FX. Solid own body, truthful physical foot contact.
